description: This file is a test class for the SudoStreamPids class, containing unit tests to verify immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and integration with a command registry within the package related to streaming services in Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: SudoStreamPidsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the SudoStreamPids class, including immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and registry parsing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of SudoStreamPids are immutable and that EntityIdWithRevision is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods for SudoStreamPids.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a SudoStreamPids instance can be correctly created from a JSON object.

methods.name: parseWithRegistry
methods.description: Validates that the GlobalCommandRegistry can parse a JSON representation into a SudoStreamPids instance.
